verdict.rationale: Circle explicitly documents x402 with endpoints/SDKs (Agent Marketplace discovery API, seller integration returning HTTP 402, Agent Nanopayments), plus Agent Wallets and CLI/MCP tooling for agent-driven payments — this is concrete named-protocol support, not aspirational messaging. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of ACP, MPP, or AP2 by name, so coverage is limited to x402 among the listed protocols.
